metric.rationale: exact under the classical attenuation null, and shared across all tests

outcome_semantics.note: a simple probe finding the shortcut proves it exists; the same probe failing proves only that it is not accessible to this model class, and does not clear a deep encoder trained against exactly this objective

population: BASE_MECHANICS cells estimable at every p (probability sample; stress strata excluded)
prospective_structural_prediction: Conditional on the original counts, thinned counts are independent binomials across addresses and the two views draw from DISJOINT address sets. The only stochastic term shared by the two views is the realized full-library denominator L_p (including its out-of-ledger component), which enters both views' normalization identically. PREDICTION: if a matched-state advantage exists, supplying L_p (and detect_p) to the clean predictor should recover nearly all of it. A residual surviving beyond the scalars would indicate a coupling not accounted for in this description of the construction.
question: Does sharing the measurement state make V0 more useful for predicting V1?

retired_before_execution.biological_signal_subtraction_claim: WITHDRAWN: observed cross-view predictability decomposes into a measured-state-associated component and a REMAINING component. The remainder is unresolved, not automatically biological -- it may hold unmeasured technical state and representation artifacts.
retired_before_execution.nuisance_matched_permutation: RETIRED: exact matching on realized (L_p, detect_p, source, operator) would leave overwhelmingly singleton strata in FULL104, and coarsening the match after observing that would be threshold widening after seeing the discrepancy. Retired prospectively rather than audited and relaxed.

scalars.transform: log1p then standardized on training folds' scale

T1_matched_state_advantage.contrast: R2(V1^p <- V0^p) vs R2(V1^p <- V0^1.0), target identical in both arms
T1_matched_state_advantage.null_direction_note: V0^1.0 is the CLEANER predictor, so the contrast is biased toward the null

T2_scalar_channel_recovery.question: how much of any matched-state advantage returns from low-dimensional realized state

T4_matrix.grid: C(p_i,p_j) = R2(V1^{p_j} <- V0^{p_i}) over the full 5x5
T4_matrix.rationale: classical attenuation identity, exact for R2 under independent per-view attenuation
